questions.questionEn: An 80-year-old in severe respiratory distress remains hypoxic with a decreasing LOC despite a non-rebreather plus nasal cannula, both at 15 L/min. As an EMR, what is your next escalation?
questions.questionZh: 一名 80 岁重度呼吸窘迫患者在非重复呼吸面罩加鼻导管（均 15 升/分）下仍缺氧且意识逐渐下降。作为 EMR，你的下一步升级措施是什么？

options.en: Provide assisted ventilations with a BVM — CPAP is a PCP-level intervention
options.zh: 用球囊面罩进行辅助通气——CPAP 属 PCP 级别的操作

options.en: Apply CPAP, which any licence level may use
options.zh: 使用 CPAP，任何级别都可以操作

options.en: Reduce the oxygen to protect the lungs
options.zh: 降低氧流量以保护肺

options.en: Wait for the saturation to improve on its own
options.zh: 等待血氧自行改善

questions.explanationEn: After maximal passive oxygen, the sequence moves to CPAP (a PCP intervention) or assisted ventilations. For an EMR, assisted ventilation with a BVM is the available next step.
questions.explanationZh: 被动给氧达到上限后，下一步是 CPAP（PCP 级操作）或辅助通气。对 EMR 而言，可执行的升级措施是球囊面罩辅助通气。

questions.questionEn: A 10-month-old has obvious respiratory distress with indrawing. Which primary survey intervention indication does this represent?
questions.questionZh: 一名 10 个月大的婴儿出现明显呼吸窘迫伴吸气性凹陷。这符合初步检查干预中哪项给氧适应证？

options.en: Oxygen is only indicated once cyanosis appears
options.zh: 只有出现紫绀后才需给氧

options.en: There is no oxygen indication in infants
options.zh: 婴儿没有给氧适应证

options.en: Respiratory distress — a listed indication for oxygen administration
options.zh: 呼吸窘迫——给氧的明确适应证之一

options.en: Oxygen requires a physician order first
options.zh: 给氧需先取得医生医嘱

questions.explanationEn: Listed oxygen indications include altered LOC, respiratory distress, trauma, evidence of shock, and hypoxia NYD. Distress alone is sufficient — do not wait for cyanosis.
questions.explanationZh: 给氧适应证包括意识改变、呼吸窘迫、创伤、休克表现及原因未明的低氧。呼吸窘迫本身即足够，不必等到紫绀出现。

questions.questionEn: Which combination of findings meets the indications for the Hypovolemia guideline?
questions.questionZh: 哪组表现符合低血容量（Hypovolemia）指南的适应证？

options.en: SBP 140 mmHg with a headache
options.zh: 收缩压 140 mmHg 伴头痛

options.en: Evidence of significant fluid or blood loss, systolic BP below 90 mmHg, and other clinical signs of shock
options.zh: 有大量失血/失液证据、收缩压低于 90 mmHg，并伴其他休克体征

options.en: Any patient with nausea alone
options.zh: 任何单纯恶心的患者

options.en: Isolated anxiety with normal vitals
options.zh: 生命体征正常的单纯焦虑

questions.explanationEn: The hypovolemia indications are: hypovolemia (evidence of significant blood or fluid loss), systolic BP < 90 mmHg, and other clinical signs or symptoms of shock; burns > 20% BSA also qualify.
questions.explanationZh: 低血容量指南的适应证为：有大量失血或失液证据、收缩压低于 90 mmHg 并伴其他休克征象；烧伤超过体表面积 20% 亦符合。

questions.questionEn: A 29-year-old with a bleeding thigh laceration is in hypovolemic shock. Which intervention is NOT within the EMR's role under the hypovolemia guideline?
questions.questionZh: 一名 29 岁大腿裂伤出血患者出现低血容量性休克。根据低血容量指南，下列哪项干预不属于 EMR 的职责范围？

options.en: Controlling the external hemorrhage
options.zh: 控制外部出血

options.en: Positioning the patient supine
options.zh: 让患者取仰卧位

options.en: Keeping the patient warm
options.zh: 为患者保暖

options.en: Administering an intravenous fluid bolus
options.zh: 静脉输液推注

questions.explanationEn: All-licence interventions are hemorrhage control, splinting, supine positioning, warmth, and oxygen. Vascular access and fluid boluses are additional PCP interventions.
questions.explanationZh: 所有级别的干预包括止血、夹板固定、仰卧位、保暖和给氧。建立静脉通路和液体推注属于 PCP 的额外干预。

questions.questionEn: How should a 78-year-old hypovolemic patient with SBP 84 mmHg be positioned?
questions.questionZh: 一名收缩压 84 mmHg 的 78 岁低血容量患者应采取什么体位？

options.en: Sitting upright at 90 degrees
options.zh: 90 度直立坐位

options.en: Prone
options.zh: 俯卧位

options.en: Standing with assistance
options.zh: 搀扶下站立

options.en: Supine, to support the blood pressure
options.zh: 仰卧位，以支持血压

questions.explanationEn: Position the hypovolemic patient supine to support blood pressure, keep them warm, and administer oxygen to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94%.
questions.explanationZh: 低血容量患者应取仰卧位以维持血压，同时保暖并给氧维持血氧 ≥ 94%。

questions.questionEn: Why is keeping a hypovolemic patient warm part of the all-licence-level interventions?
questions.questionZh: 为什么“保暖并防止进一步热量丢失”是低血容量处理中所有级别都要执行的干预？

options.en: Warmth makes the patient easier to move
options.zh: 保暖能让患者更容易搬运

options.en: The guideline directs keeping the patient warm and protecting from further heat loss as part of shock care
options.zh: 指南要求在休克处理中为患者保暖并防止进一步失温

options.en: It is only for patient comfort and may be skipped
options.zh: 仅为舒适考虑，可以省略

options.en: Heat replaces lost fluid volume
options.zh: 热量可以补充丢失的液体量

questions.explanationEn: The hypovolemia interventions for all licence levels include keeping the patient warm and protecting them from further heat loss, alongside hemorrhage control, supine positioning, and oxygen.
questions.explanationZh: 低血容量指南要求所有级别为患者保暖、防止进一步热量丢失，与止血、仰卧位和给氧并列。

questions.questionEn: A cyclist took handlebars to the abdomen. He is pale and tachycardic but his systolic BP is 102 mmHg. Can the hypovolemia guideline be applied?
questions.questionZh: 一名骑行者腹部撞上车把。他面色苍白、心动过速，但收缩压为 102 mmHg。可以应用低血容量指南吗？

options.en: No — the guideline is forbidden above 90 mmHg
options.zh: 不能——收缩压高于 90 mmHg 时禁止使用该指南

options.en: No — abdominal injuries are excluded
options.zh: 不能——腹部损伤不在适用范围

options.en: Yes — it may be used above 90 mmHg when shock is anticipated from the mechanism, injuries, or condition
options.zh: 可以——当受伤机制、损伤或病情预示休克时，血压高于 90 mmHg 也可使用

options.en: Only if he loses consciousness first
options.zh: 只有他先失去意识才可以

questions.explanationEn: The footnote states the hypovolemia protocol may be used for patients with BP above 90 mmHg if shock is anticipated because of the mechanism of injury, the nature and extent of the injuries, or the patient's condition.
questions.explanationZh: 指南脚注说明：若因受伤机制、损伤性质与程度或病情预计将发生休克，血压高于 90 mmHg 的患者也可使用低血容量方案。

questions.questionEn: Which burn injury is a listed indication for the hypovolemia guideline?
questions.questionZh: 哪种烧伤是低血容量指南所列的适应证？

options.en: Burns covering more than 20% of body surface area (partial and full thickness)
options.zh: 烧伤面积超过体表面积 20%（部分及全皮层）

options.en: Any sunburn
options.zh: 任何晒伤

options.en: A blistered fingertip
options.zh: 起水疱的指尖烫伤

options.en: Burns are never related to hypovolemia
options.zh: 烧伤与低血容量无关

questions.explanationEn: Patients with burns greater than 20% BSA (partial and full thickness) are an indication for the hypovolemia guideline, because large burns cause major fluid loss.
questions.explanationZh: 烧伤面积大于体表 20%（部分及全皮层）是低血容量指南的适应证，因为大面积烧伤造成大量体液丢失。

questions.questionEn: An 81-year-old who fell has HR 118, RR 24, BP 96/70, and pale, cool, clammy skin. What is the correct EMR management?
questions.questionZh: 一名跌倒的 81 岁患者：心率 118、呼吸 24、血压 96/70，皮肤苍白湿冷。EMR 的正确处理是什么？

options.en: Sit her in a chair and observe for 20 minutes
options.zh: 让她坐在椅子上观察 20 分钟

options.en: Withhold oxygen because BP is above 90
options.zh: 因血压高于 90 而不给氧

options.en: Treat as shock: supine, keep warm, high-flow oxygen, and prompt transport
options.zh: 按休克处理：仰卧、保暖、高流量给氧并尽快转运

options.en: Give her juice to drink for energy
options.zh: 给她喝果汁补充能量

questions.explanationEn: Tachycardia, tachypnea, and cool pale clammy skin are evidence of shock — an unstable presentation. Shocked patients require high-flow oxygen, supine position, warmth, and transport.
questions.explanationZh: 心动过速、呼吸增快及皮肤苍白湿冷是休克证据——属不稳定表现。休克患者需要高流量氧、仰卧位、保暖并转运。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old on warfarin reports two days of black, tarry stools and now feels faint. SBP is 86 mmHg, skin is pale and clammy. There is no external bleeding. What is the best EMR response?
questions.questionZh: 一名服用华法林的 79 岁患者自述黑色柏油样便两天，现感到快要晕倒。收缩压 86 mmHg，皮肤苍白湿冷，无外部出血。EMR 的最佳处理是什么？

options.en: Recognize occult GI hemorrhage causing hypovolemic shock: supine, keep warm, oxygen to SpO2 ≥ 94%, and rapid transport
options.zh: 识别隐性消化道出血导致的低血容量性休克：仰卧、保暖、给氧维持血氧 ≥ 94%，并快速转运

options.en: There is no shock because there is no visible bleeding
options.zh: 没有可见出血就不存在休克

options.en: Have him walk to the stretcher to save time
options.zh: 为节省时间让他自行走到担架

options.en: Give oral fluids to replace the volume
options.zh: 口服补液以补充血容量

questions.explanationEn: Melena is evidence of significant blood loss even without external bleeding. With SBP < 90 and signs of shock, this meets the hypovolemia indications; EMR care is positioning, warmth, oxygen, and transport (fluids and TXA are PCP).
questions.explanationZh: 柏油样便即为大量失血的证据，即使无外部出血。收缩压低于 90 且伴休克征象符合低血容量适应证；EMR 的处理为体位、保暖、给氧和转运（补液与 TXA 属 PCP）。

questions.questionEn: A 3-year-old with two days of vomiting and diarrhea is lethargic with mottled skin, rapid weak pulse, and dry lips. What is the correct EMR management?
questions.questionZh: 一名呕吐腹泻两天的 3 岁患儿嗜睡、皮肤花斑、脉搏快而弱、口唇干燥。EMR 的正确处理是什么？

options.en: Encourage a large drink of water and leave at home
options.zh: 鼓励大量喝水并留在家中

options.en: Only reassess in the morning
options.zh: 等到早晨再评估

options.en: Give oral glucose for energy
options.zh: 给口服葡萄糖补充能量

options.en: Treat as shock from fluid loss: position supine, keep warm, give oxygen, and transport promptly
options.zh: 按体液丢失所致休克处理：仰卧、保暖、给氧并尽快转运

questions.explanationEn: Hypovolemia includes loss of body fluids, not just blood. A lethargic child with poor perfusion after GI losses is in shock and needs supine positioning, warmth, oxygen, and prompt transport.
questions.explanationZh: 低血容量包括体液丢失，不仅是失血。消化道失液后灌注不良、嗜睡的患儿已处于休克，需要仰卧、保暖、给氧并尽快转运。

questions.questionEn: To support a diagnosis of hypovolemia in an infant, what evidence does the guideline require?
questions.questionZh: 要支持婴儿低血容量的判断，指南要求什么证据？

options.en: A fever above 39°C
options.zh: 体温超过 39°C

options.en: Evidence of loss of a significant quantity of blood or body fluids
options.zh: 有大量血液或体液丢失的证据

options.en: A history of asthma
options.zh: 哮喘病史

options.en: A rash on the trunk
options.zh: 躯干皮疹

questions.explanationEn: The guideline footnote directs obtaining evidence of loss of a significant quantity of blood or body fluids (e.g., bleeding, vomiting, diarrhea) to support a diagnosis of hypovolemia.
questions.explanationZh: 指南脚注要求获取大量血液或体液丢失（如出血、呕吐、腹泻）的证据来支持低血容量的判断。

questions.questionEn: What is the first-line method for controlling major external hemorrhage?
questions.questionZh: 控制严重外出血的首选方法是什么？

options.en: Immediate tourniquet on every bleeding limb
options.zh: 对所有出血肢体立即上止血带

options.en: Direct pressure
options.zh: 直接压迫

options.en: Wound packing
options.zh: 伤口填塞

options.en: Ice applied to the wound
options.zh: 伤口冰敷

questions.explanationEn: The order of preference for hemorrhage control begins with direct pressure, then pressure dressing, positioning the part and patient, tourniquet, and finally extremity wound packing.
questions.explanationZh: 止血方法的优先顺序从直接压迫开始，其后为加压敷料、抬高患肢与调整患者体位、止血带，最后是肢体伤口填塞。

questions.questionEn: A chainsaw laceration to the forearm is spurting blood that direct pressure has failed to control. What should you do next?
questions.questionZh: 前臂被链锯割伤后喷射状出血，直接压迫未能止血。接下来应该怎么做？

options.en: Continue direct pressure only and transport
options.zh: 仅继续直接压迫并转运

options.en: Pack the wound with gauze first
options.zh: 先用纱布填塞伤口

options.en: Elevate the arm and wait five minutes
options.zh: 抬高手臂并等待五分钟

options.en: Apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound
options.zh: 在伤口近端使用止血带

questions.explanationEn: If direct pressure does not control bleeding and the wound is in an area amenable to a tourniquet (an extremity), apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound.
questions.explanationZh: 若直接压迫无法止血且伤口位于可使用止血带的部位（肢体），应在伤口近端上止血带。

questions.questionEn: A stab wound at the groin crease is bleeding heavily and direct pressure is not controlling it. A tourniquet cannot be positioned there. What is indicated?
questions.questionZh: 腹股沟处刺伤大量出血，直接压迫无法控制，该部位又无法上止血带。应采取什么措施？

options.en: Wound packing — the junctional site is not amenable to a tourniquet
options.zh: 伤口填塞——交界部位无法使用止血带

options.en: A loose dressing and rapid transport only
options.zh: 仅松散敷料覆盖后快速转运

options.en: A tourniquet around the abdomen
options.zh: 在腹部环绕止血带

options.en: Elevation of both legs
options.zh: 抬高双下肢

questions.explanationEn: If direct pressure fails and the wound is not in an area amenable to tourniquet application (junctional hemorrhage), consider wound packing.
questions.explanationZh: 当直接压迫无效且伤口位于不适合止血带的部位（交界性出血）时，应考虑伤口填塞。

questions.questionEn: Wound packing must NOT be performed on wounds in which locations?
questions.questionZh: 哪些部位的伤口不得进行伤口填塞？

options.en: The thigh and upper arm
options.zh: 大腿和上臂

options.en: The scalp and forehead
options.zh: 头皮和前额

options.en: The neck, chest, and abdomen
options.zh: 颈部、胸部和腹部

options.en: The hands and feet
options.zh: 手和足

questions.explanationEn: The guideline is explicit: do not pack wounds on the neck, chest, or abdomen. Packing is considered for junctional and extremity wounds when pressure fails.
questions.explanationZh: 指南明确规定：颈部、胸部和腹部的伤口不得填塞。填塞适用于压迫无效的交界部位和肢体伤口。

questions.questionEn: After applying a tourniquet, which two rules must be followed?
questions.questionZh: 使用止血带后必须遵守哪两条规则？

options.en: Note the time of application and do not release it once applied
options.zh: 记录上带时间，且一经使用不得松开

options.en: Loosen it every 10 minutes and massage the limb
options.zh: 每 10 分钟松开一次并按摩肢体

options.en: Cover it so hospital staff are not alarmed
options.zh: 盖住止血带以免医院人员紧张

options.en: Remove it as soon as bleeding slows
options.zh: 出血减缓后立即撤除

questions.explanationEn: When a tourniquet is applied, note the time and do not release it once applied — release is a hospital decision.
questions.explanationZh: 使用止血带时应记录时间，且一经上带不得自行松开——是否松开由医院决定。

questions.questionEn: A 76-year-old on anticoagulants has a briskly bleeding shin laceration. Direct pressure slows but does not stop it. In the order of preference, what comes next?
questions.questionZh: 一名服抗凝药的 76 岁患者小腿裂伤出血较快，直接压迫使出血减缓但未停止。按优先顺序，下一步是什么？

options.en: An immediate tourniquet at the hip
options.zh: 立即在髋部上止血带

options.en: Wound packing of the shin
options.zh: 对小腿伤口进行填塞

options.en: A pressure dressing
options.zh: 加压敷料

options.en: Dry ice over the wound
options.zh: 伤口上放干冰

questions.explanationEn: The order of preference is: direct pressure, pressure dressing, positioning the part, positioning the patient, tourniquet, then extremity wound packing if the bleed cannot be controlled.
questions.explanationZh: 优先顺序为：直接压迫、加压敷料、抬高患肢、调整患者体位、止血带，仍无法控制时行肢体伤口填塞。

questions.questionEn: A 9-year-old's finger was completely amputated by a slammed door. Bleeding is controlled. How should the amputated finger be cared for?
questions.questionZh: 一名 9 岁儿童的手指被重重关上的门完全离断。出血已控制。应如何处理离断的手指？

options.en: Place it directly on ice in a cup
options.zh: 直接放在杯中的冰块上

options.en: Rinse off gross debris with cool sterile water, wrap loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, place in a plastic bag, keep cool, and transport with the patient
options.zh: 用凉的无菌水冲去明显污物，用生理盐水湿润的无菌纱布松松包裹，装入塑料袋保持低温，随患者一同转运

options.en: Submerge it in a bottle of water
options.zh: 浸泡在一瓶水中

options.en: Leave it at the scene for police
options.zh: 留在现场交给警察

questions.explanationEn: Rinse with cool sterile water, wrap loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, place in a plastic bag, keep cool in a protective container, and transport with the patient.
questions.explanationZh: 应以凉的无菌水冲洗、用生理盐水湿润的无菌纱布松松包裹、装入塑料袋置于保护容器中保持低温，并随患者一同转运。

questions.questionEn: Which action would damage an amputated part and must be avoided?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪种做法会损害离断的肢体部分，必须避免？

options.en: Wrapping it in saline-moistened gauze
options.zh: 用生理盐水湿润的纱布包裹

options.en: Keeping it cool in a protective container
options.zh: 放入保护容器中保持低温

options.en: Transporting it with the patient
options.zh: 随患者一同转运

options.en: Placing the part directly on ice
options.zh: 将离断部分直接放在冰上

questions.explanationEn: Never place the part directly on ice, in water, or use dry ice, and do not warm it. Direct ice contact causes freezing injury that can prevent reattachment.
questions.explanationZh: 绝不能将离断部分直接放在冰上、浸入水中或使用干冰，也不要加温。直接接触冰会造成冻伤，可能导致无法再植。

questions.questionEn: A 33-year-old has a screwdriver embedded in his lateral thigh. It is not bleeding heavily and his airway is clear. How should the object be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名 33 岁男性大腿外侧插着一把螺丝刀，出血不多，气道通畅。应如何处理该异物？

options.en: Pull it out smoothly to allow proper bandaging
options.zh: 平稳拔出以便妥善包扎

options.en: Rock it gently to check the depth
options.zh: 轻轻摇动以判断深度

options.en: Remove it only if transport is longer than 20 minutes
options.zh: 仅当转运超过 20 分钟时才拔除

options.en: Stabilize it in place with bulky dressings and immobilize the limb
options.zh: 用大块敷料原位固定并制动该肢体

questions.explanationEn: Embedded objects should be stabilized in place unless they impair the airway. Removal can trigger uncontrolled bleeding; immobilize limbs with large wounds or wounds over joints.
questions.explanationZh: 嵌入的异物应原位固定，除非其妨碍气道。拔除可能引发无法控制的出血；大伤口或跨关节伤口的肢体应予制动。

questions.questionEn: A 55-year-old has crushing central chest pressure radiating to his jaw. Which medication may an EMR administer under the cardiac chest pain guideline?
questions.questionZh: 一名 55 岁男性出现胸骨后压榨性疼痛并放射至下颌。根据心源性胸痛指南，EMR 可以给予哪种药物？

options.en: Acetylsalicylic acid (ASA), chewed and swallowed
options.zh: 阿司匹林（ASA），嚼碎后吞服

options.en: Intravenous morphine
options.zh: 静脉注射吗啡

options.en: Dimenhydrinate for nausea
options.zh: 苯海拉明类止吐药（茶苯海明）

options.en: An intravenous fluid bolus
options.zh: 静脉推注液体

questions.explanationEn: Interventions of all licence levels include administering ASA chewed and swallowed if not already taken. Dimenhydrinate and vascular access are additional PCP interventions.
questions.explanationZh: 所有级别的干预包括在患者尚未服用时给予嚼服阿司匹林。茶苯海明和建立静脉通路属于 PCP 的额外干预。

questions.questionEn: What is the ASA dose for a patient with suspected cardiac chest pain?
questions.questionZh: 对疑似心源性胸痛的患者，阿司匹林的剂量是多少？

options.en: 80 mg PO
options.zh: 口服 80 毫克

options.en: 160 mg PO
options.zh: 口服 160 毫克

options.en: 325 mg SL
options.zh: 舌下 325 毫克

options.en: 500 mg PO
options.zh: 口服 500 毫克

questions.explanationEn: The ASA monograph specifies 160 mg PO, with an onset of 20 minutes to one hour if chewed.
questions.explanationZh: 阿司匹林药物专论规定剂量为口服 160 毫克，嚼服后 20 分钟至 1 小时起效。

questions.questionEn: A 74-year-old with chest pain tells you she took her own 81 mg Aspirin an hour ago as she does every day. Should you give ASA under the chest pain guideline?
questions.questionZh: 一名 74 岁胸痛患者告诉你，她像每天一样在一小时前服了自己的 81 毫克阿司匹林。根据胸痛指南是否应给予 ASA？

options.en: No — she has taken Aspirin today, so no further dose is needed
options.zh: 不给——她今天已服过阿司匹林，无需再加量

options.en: Give 160 mg — her daily low-dose Aspirin is not the recommended treatment dose for cardiac ischemia
options.zh: 给 160 毫克——她的每日小剂量阿司匹林并非心肌缺血的推荐治疗剂量

options.en: Give 500 mg to be safe
options.zh: 保险起见给 500 毫克

options.en: Give ASA only after Nitroglycerin fails
options.zh: 仅在硝酸甘油无效后才给 ASA

questions.explanationEn: The contraindication is that the patient has already taken their recommended Aspirin dose (160 mg) prior to arrival. A routine daily 81 mg tablet is not the treatment dose, so ASA is still indicated.
questions.explanationZh: 禁忌证是患者在到达前已服用推荐治疗剂量（160 毫克）的阿司匹林。日常 81 毫克并非治疗剂量，因此仍应给药。

questions.questionEn: Which patient with cardiac chest pain should NOT receive ASA?
questions.questionZh: 哪位心源性胸痛患者不应给予阿司匹林？

options.en: A 62-year-old who takes a statin daily
options.zh: 一名每日服用他汀的 62 岁患者

options.en: A 70-year-old with well-controlled hypertension
options.zh: 一名高血压控制良好的 70 岁患者

options.en: A 68-year-old with a known active peptic ulcer
options.zh: 一名已知活动性消化性溃疡的 68 岁患者

options.en: A 59-year-old smoker with a family history of MI
options.zh: 一名有心梗家族史的 59 岁吸烟者

questions.explanationEn: ASA contraindications include inability to swallow or Aspirin allergy, active peptic ulcer or GI bleeding, having already taken the recommended dose, salicylate/NSAID-induced asthma, and pediatric patients with viral symptoms.
questions.explanationZh: 阿司匹林禁忌证包括无法吞咽或过敏、活动性消化性溃疡或消化道出血、已服用推荐剂量、水杨酸/非甾体类诱发哮喘史，以及有病毒症状的儿童。

questions.questionEn: Which statement about ASA administration is unique among the medications in the guidelines?
questions.questionZh: 关于阿司匹林给药，下列哪项说法在指南所列药物中是独有的？

options.en: It requires a blood glucose reading first
options.zh: 给药前需先测血糖

options.en: It requires two attendants to witness the dose
options.zh: 需两名施救者共同见证给药

options.en: It must be given before the primary survey
options.zh: 必须在初步检查之前给予

options.en: It is the only medication for which vital signs are not required prior to administration
options.zh: 它是唯一在给药前不要求先测生命体征的药物

questions.explanationEn: The ASA monograph notes it is the only medication for which vital signs are not required prior to administration, though it should follow the rapid body survey.
questions.explanationZh: 阿司匹林专论指出，它是唯一无需在给药前测量生命体征的药物，但仍应在快速全身检查之后给予。

questions.questionEn: A 58-year-old with cardiac chest pain has SpO2 of 91% on room air. How should oxygen be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名 58 岁心源性胸痛患者在室内空气下血氧为 91%。应如何处理氧疗？

options.en: Withhold oxygen — it masks cardiac symptoms
options.zh: 不给氧——氧疗会掩盖心脏症状

options.en: Apply oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 at or above 94%
options.zh: 按需给氧，使血氧维持在 94% 及以上

options.en: Give high-flow oxygen for 30 minutes then stop entirely
options.zh: 高流量给氧 30 分钟后完全停止

options.en: Oxygen is only for patients in cardiac arrest
options.zh: 氧疗只用于心搏骤停患者

questions.explanationEn: The cardiac chest pain guideline directs completing a primary survey and applying oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94%.
questions.explanationZh: 心源性胸痛指南要求完成初步检查并按需给氧，使血氧维持在 94% 以上。

questions.questionEn: How should a patient with suspected cardiac chest pain be positioned and moved?
questions.questionZh: 疑似心源性胸痛的患者应如何摆放体位和搬动？

options.en: Walk the patient to the ambulance to assess exercise tolerance
options.zh: 让患者步行到救护车以评估运动耐量

options.en: Place them prone to reduce cardiac workload
options.zh: 取俯卧位以减少心脏负荷

options.en: Place them in a position of comfort as their condition permits, and generally limit patient movement
options.zh: 在病情允许下取舒适体位，并尽量减少患者活动

options.en: Have them lie flat with legs elevated regardless of comfort
options.zh: 无论是否舒适都平卧并抬高双腿

questions.explanationEn: The guideline directs placing the patient in a position of comfort as permitted by clinical condition and, in general, limiting patient movement to reduce cardiac oxygen demand.
questions.explanationZh: 指南要求在临床情况允许下让患者取舒适体位，并总体上限制活动，以降低心肌耗氧。

questions.questionEn: A 71-year-old with cardiac chest pain has his own prescribed Nitroglycerin spray. His BP is 104/62 and HR is 78. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名 71 岁心源性胸痛患者自备处方硝酸甘油喷雾。血压 104/62，心率 78。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Assist with one dose since it is his own prescription
options.zh: 因为是他自己的处方药，可协助给一剂

options.en: Withhold Nitroglycerin — his systolic BP is below 110 mmHg
options.zh: 暂不给硝酸甘油——他的收缩压低于 110 mmHg

options.en: Give two doses back-to-back to relieve the pain faster
options.zh: 连续给两剂以更快缓解疼痛

options.en: Have him stand up first to raise the blood pressure
options.zh: 先让他站起来以升高血压

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin is contraindicated with a systolic BP below 110 mmHg, HR below 50 or above 150, nitrate allergy, or recent PDE-5 inhibitor use.
questions.explanationZh: 硝酸甘油的禁忌证包括收缩压低于 110 mmHg、心率低于 50 或高于 150、硝酸酯类过敏，以及近期使用 PDE-5 抑制剂。

questions.questionEn: A 60-year-old with chest pain mentions he took Viagra last night, about 14 hours ago. His BP is 138/84. What is the correct action regarding Nitroglycerin?
questions.questionZh: 一名 60 岁胸痛患者提到昨晚约 14 小时前服用了万艾可（伟哥）。血压 138/84。关于硝酸甘油的正确处理是什么？

options.en: Give Nitroglycerin — his blood pressure is adequate
options.zh: 给硝酸甘油——他的血压足够

options.en: Give a half dose as a compromise
options.zh: 折中给半剂

options.en: Withhold Nitroglycerin — Viagra use within the past 24 hours is a contraindication
options.zh: 不给硝酸甘油——24 小时内使用过万艾可属禁忌

options.en: Give it only if he lies flat first
options.zh: 只要他先平卧就可以给

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin is contraindicated if the patient has used Viagra or Levitra in the past 24 hours, or Cialis in the last 48 hours, due to the risk of profound hypotension.
questions.explanationZh: 若患者在过去 24 小时内使用过万艾可或艾力达，或 48 小时内使用过希爱力，则禁用硝酸甘油，因有严重低血压风险。

questions.questionEn: What is the Nitroglycerin dosing interval and maximum in any 30-minute period for cardiac chest pain?
questions.questionZh: 治疗心源性胸痛时，硝酸甘油的给药间隔和 30 分钟内的最大剂量是多少？

options.en: 0.4 mg SL every 3-5 minutes, to a maximum of 3 doses in any 30-minute period
options.zh: 舌下 0.4 毫克，每 3-5 分钟一次，30 分钟内最多 3 剂

options.en: 0.8 mg SL every 10 minutes with no maximum
options.zh: 舌下 0.8 毫克，每 10 分钟一次，无上限

options.en: 0.4 mg SL once only per call
options.zh: 每次出勤仅给舌下 0.4 毫克一剂

options.en: 0.4 mg SL every minute until pain free
options.zh: 舌下 0.4 毫克，每分钟一次直至疼痛消失

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin is 0.4 mg SL every 3-5 minutes provided systolic BP remains above 110, to a maximum of 3 doses in any 30-minute period — irrespective of any Nitro the patient took before your arrival.
questions.explanationZh: 硝酸甘油为舌下 0.4 毫克，每 3-5 分钟一次（前提是收缩压持续高于 110），30 分钟内最多 3 剂——与患者在你到达前自服的剂量无关。

questions.questionEn: A 69-year-old's chest pain was fully relieved after Nitroglycerin, but 8 minutes later it returns identically. What does the guideline permit?
questions.questionZh: 一名 69 岁患者用硝酸甘油后胸痛完全缓解，但 8 分钟后疼痛以相同性质复发。指南允许怎么做？

options.en: Nothing further can be given for the rest of the call
options.zh: 本次出勤内不能再给任何药

options.en: Re-initiate the Nitroglycerin component, but not the Aspirin component
options.zh: 可重新启动硝酸甘油部分，但不重复阿司匹林部分

options.en: Repeat both the Nitroglycerin and a second dose of Aspirin
options.zh: 硝酸甘油和阿司匹林第二剂都可重复

options.en: Switch immediately to Entonox without reassessing
options.zh: 不再评估直接改用安桃乐

questions.explanationEn: If pain is completely relieved for more than 5 minutes and then returns, you may re-initiate the Nitroglycerin component of the chest pain protocol, but not the Aspirin component.
questions.explanationZh: 若疼痛完全缓解超过 5 分钟后复发，可重新启动胸痛方案的硝酸甘油部分，但不再重复阿司匹林部分。

questions.questionEn: A 57-year-old still has chest pain after 3 doses of Nitroglycerin, given most recently 5 minutes ago. His SBP is now 106 mmHg. What does the guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 57 岁患者在使用 3 剂硝酸甘油后仍有胸痛，最近一剂在 5 分钟前给予，目前收缩压 106 mmHg。指南要求怎么做？

options.en: Give a fourth dose of Nitroglycerin now
options.zh: 立即给第四剂硝酸甘油

options.en: Give no further analgesia of any kind
options.zh: 不再给予任何镇痛

options.en: Administer Entonox, 5 minutes after the last dose of Nitroglycerin
options.zh: 在最后一剂硝酸甘油后 5 分钟给予安桃乐（Entonox）

options.en: Start an IV and give morphine
options.zh: 建立静脉通路并给吗啡

questions.explanationEn: If pain persists beyond 3 doses of Nitroglycerin, or if SBP falls below 110 mmHg, administer Entonox 5 minutes after the last Nitroglycerin dose, continuing assessment and vitals every 5 minutes.
questions.explanationZh: 若 3 剂硝酸甘油后疼痛仍持续，或收缩压降至 110 mmHg 以下，应在最后一剂硝酸甘油 5 分钟后给予安桃乐，并每 5 分钟继续评估和测量生命体征。

questions.questionEn: Which finding is a contraindication to Entonox in a patient with an isolated painful injury?
questions.questionZh: 对单纯疼痛性损伤的患者，下列哪项是使用安桃乐（Entonox）的禁忌证？

options.en: An altered level of consciousness
options.zh: 意识水平改变

options.en: A pulse of 92 beats per minute
options.zh: 脉搏 92 次/分

options.en: Pain rated 8 out of 10
options.zh: 疼痛评分 8/10

options.en: A history of hypertension
options.zh: 高血压病史

questions.explanationEn: Entonox contraindications include inability to comply, inability to ventilate the area, decompression sickness, altered LOC, pneumothorax, air embolism, inhalation injury, and Nitroglycerin in the last 5 minutes.
questions.explanationZh: 安桃乐的禁忌证包括无法配合、治疗区域无法通风、减压病、意识改变、气胸、空气栓塞、吸入性损伤，以及 5 分钟内使用过硝酸甘油。

questions.questionEn: For a patient with cardiac chest pain who is able to be moved promptly, when should transport be initiated?
questions.questionZh: 对可以尽快搬动的心源性胸痛患者，应在什么时候开始转运？

options.en: Only after all three Nitroglycerin doses are complete
options.zh: 必须等三剂硝酸甘油全部给完

options.en: Only after the head-to-toe examination
options.zh: 必须等从头到脚检查完成

options.en: After arrival of an advanced care crew
options.zh: 等高级救护车组到达后

options.en: Immediately if able; transport after the first Nitroglycerin dose if not already underway
options.zh: 若条件允许立即转运；若尚未启动，则在第一剂硝酸甘油后转运

questions.explanationEn: The guideline directs initiating transport immediately if able (delegating crew to prep egress otherwise), and transporting after the first Nitroglycerin dose if transport has not already begun.
questions.explanationZh: 指南要求若条件允许应立即转运（否则安排队员准备撤离通道），若尚未开始转运，则在第一剂硝酸甘油后启动转运。

questions.questionEn: How should a conscious patient with an asthma exacerbation be positioned?
questions.questionZh: 哮喘急性发作的清醒患者应采取什么体位？

options.en: Seated leaning forward, in a position of comfort, with movement limited
options.zh: 坐位前倾的舒适体位，并限制活动

options.en: Supine with the legs elevated
options.zh: 仰卧并抬高双腿

options.en: Left lateral recovery position
options.zh: 左侧卧复原体位

options.en: Prone with a pillow under the chest
options.zh: 俯卧并在胸下垫枕

questions.explanationEn: The SOB guideline directs a position of comfort as the clinical condition permits — generally seated leaning forward — and limiting patient movement.
questions.explanationZh: 呼吸困难指南要求在病情允许下取舒适体位——通常为坐位前倾——并限制患者活动。

questions.questionEn: A 44-year-old asthmatic is wheezing and short of breath. Which medication may an EMR assist with under the SOB guideline?
questions.questionZh: 一名 44 岁哮喘患者喘鸣伴呼吸困难。根据呼吸困难指南，EMR 可协助使用哪种药物？

options.en: Ipratropium by nebulizer
options.zh: 异丙托溴铵雾化

options.en: Salbutamol by nebulizer or MDI
options.zh: 沙丁胺醇雾化或定量吸入器

options.en: Dexamethasone orally
options.zh: 口服地塞米松

options.en: Intramuscular Epinephrine for bronchospasm
options.zh: 肌注肾上腺素治疗支气管痉挛

questions.explanationEn: Salbutamol by nebulizer or MDI is an intervention of all licence levels. Ipratropium, dexamethasone, IM epinephrine for bronchospasm, and CPAP are additional PCP interventions.
questions.explanationZh: 沙丁胺醇雾化或定量吸入属于所有级别的干预。异丙托溴铵、地塞米松、用于支气管痉挛的肌注肾上腺素及 CPAP 属 PCP 额外干预。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old COPD patient with flu-like symptoms needs Salbutamol. Which delivery method is strongly recommended?
questions.questionZh: 一名有流感样症状的 72 岁慢阻肺患者需要使用沙丁胺醇。强烈推荐哪种给药方式？

options.en: Nebulizer at high flow to maximize the dose
options.zh: 高流量雾化以最大化剂量

options.en: Oral tablets instead of inhalation
options.zh: 改用口服片剂而非吸入

options.en: MDI with a spacer
options.zh: 定量吸入器配储雾罐

options.en: Nebulizer without a mask
options.zh: 不戴面罩的雾化

questions.explanationEn: MDI and spacer use is strongly recommended for patients with signs of influenza-like illness or other infectious respiratory conditions, because nebulizers aerosolize infectious particles.
questions.explanationZh: 对有流感样疾病或其他感染性呼吸道疾病表现的患者，强烈推荐使用定量吸入器加储雾罐，因为雾化会产生传染性气溶胶。

questions.questionEn: A 40-year-old asthmatic is being ventilated with a BVM because of respiratory failure. How should Salbutamol be delivered?
questions.questionZh: 一名 40 岁哮喘患者因呼吸衰竭正在使用球囊面罩通气。应如何给予沙丁胺醇？

options.en: Stop ventilating and have the patient self-administer the MDI
options.zh: 停止通气，让患者自行使用定量吸入器

options.en: Administer the MDI via the side port on the BVM
options.zh: 通过球囊面罩的侧孔给予定量吸入剂

options.en: Give it orally between breaths
options.zh: 在通气间隙口服给药

options.en: Withhold Salbutamol until the patient breathes spontaneously
options.zh: 等患者恢复自主呼吸后再给沙丁胺醇

questions.explanationEn: The SOB guideline states that if the patient is ventilated, administer the MDI via the side port on the BVM.
questions.explanationZh: 呼吸困难指南规定：若患者正在接受通气，应通过球囊面罩的侧孔给予定量吸入剂。

questions.questionEn: What SpO2 target applies when giving supplemental oxygen to a patient with an asthma or COPD exacerbation?
questions.questionZh: 对哮喘或慢阻肺急性发作患者给氧时，血氧饱和度的目标是多少？

options.en: At or above 94%, with the caution that it may not be achievable
options.zh: 94% 及以上，但需注意可能无法达到

options.en: Exactly 100%
options.zh: 必须达到 100%

options.en: Below 90% to preserve respiratory drive
options.zh: 低于 90% 以保留呼吸驱动

questions.explanationEn: The guideline directs supplemental oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94%, with the caution that this may not be achievable in some chronic respiratory patients.
questions.explanationZh: 指南要求按需给氧维持血氧 ≥ 94%，并提醒某些慢性呼吸疾病患者可能无法达到该目标。

questions.questionEn: A 6-year-old asthmatic weighing about 22 kg needs Salbutamol by nebulizer. What is the correct nebulized dose?
questions.questionZh: 一名体重约 22 公斤的 6 岁哮喘患儿需要雾化沙丁胺醇。正确的雾化剂量是多少？

options.en: 2.5 mg, because he is under 12 years old
options.zh: 2.5 毫克，因为他不满 12 岁

options.en: 5 mg, the dose for patients older than 1 year
options.zh: 5 毫克，即 1 岁以上患者的剂量

options.en: 10 mg because of his weight
options.zh: 按体重给 10 毫克

options.en: Salbutamol is not indicated in children
options.zh: 儿童不适用沙丁胺醇

questions.explanationEn: The Salbutamol monograph gives 5 mg nebulized for age over 1 year and 2.5 mg for age under 1 year, repeated as required.
questions.explanationZh: 沙丁胺醇专论规定：1 岁以上雾化 5 毫克，1 岁以下 2.5 毫克，可按需重复。

questions.questionEn: Which assessment does the SOB guideline specifically require beyond the primary survey?
questions.questionZh: 除初步检查外，呼吸困难指南特别要求进行哪项评估？

options.en: Auscultation of the chest
options.zh: 胸部听诊

options.en: A 12-lead ECG
options.zh: 12 导联心电图

options.en: Peak flow measurement
options.zh: 峰流速测定

options.en: A chest x-ray on arrival
options.zh: 到院时的胸片

questions.explanationEn: The SOB with history of asthma/COPD guideline lists auscultation among the interventions of all licence levels, alongside positioning, oxygen, transport, history, vitals, and Salbutamol.
questions.explanationZh: 哮喘/慢阻肺相关呼吸困难指南将听诊列为所有级别的干预项目之一，与体位、给氧、转运、病史、生命体征和沙丁胺醇并列。

questions.questionEn: A 77-year-old in severe respiratory distress from a COPD exacerbation is not improving after Salbutamol. A bystander who is an off-duty nurse suggests you apply the CPAP unit in the ambulance. As an EMR, what should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名 77 岁慢阻肺急性发作、重度呼吸窘迫的患者在使用沙丁胺醇后无改善。一名休班护士旁观者建议你使用救护车上的 CPAP。作为 EMR，你应该怎么做？

options.en: Apply CPAP since a nurse recommended it
options.zh: 既然护士建议，就使用 CPAP

options.en: Decline CPAP — it is a PCP-level intervention — and continue oxygen, repeat Salbutamol, and consider assisted ventilations while transporting
options.zh: 拒绝使用 CPAP——那是 PCP 级别的操作——继续给氧、重复沙丁胺醇，必要时辅助通气并转运

options.en: Apply CPAP but at the lowest pressure setting
options.zh: 使用 CPAP 但调到最低压力

options.en: Stop all treatment until a PCP crew arrives
options.zh: 停止一切处理，等 PCP 车组到达

questions.explanationEn: CPAP is explicitly designated a PCP intervention in both the SOB guideline and the oxygen escalation sequence. An EMR continues oxygen, repeats Salbutamol as required, and may assist ventilations.
questions.explanationZh: CPAP 在呼吸困难指南和氧疗升级顺序中均被明确标注为 PCP 级操作。EMR 应继续给氧、按需重复沙丁胺醇，并可进行辅助通气。

questions.questionEn: Which intervention for a hypovolemic trauma patient is outside the EMR scope and listed as an additional PCP intervention?
questions.questionZh: 对低血容量创伤患者的哪项干预超出 EMR 范围，被列为 PCP 的额外干预？

options.en: Controlling external hemorrhage with a tourniquet
options.zh: 用止血带控制外出血

options.en: Splinting the pelvis
options.zh: 骨盆固定

options.en: Administering tranexamic acid
options.zh: 给予氨甲环酸（TXA）

options.en: Keeping the patient warm
options.zh: 为患者保暖

questions.explanationEn: Vascular access, fluid boluses, and tranexamic acid are additional PCP interventions in the hypovolemia guideline; hemorrhage control, splinting, positioning, warmth, and oxygen are for all licence levels.
questions.explanationZh: 在低血容量指南中，建立静脉通路、液体推注和氨甲环酸属 PCP 额外干预；止血、夹板固定、体位、保暖和给氧适用于所有级别。

questions.questionEn: A patient in cardiac arrest has a history suggesting a reversible cause. Which of the following is a listed treatable cause of cardiac arrest?
questions.questionZh: 一名心搏骤停患者的病史提示可能存在可逆病因。下列哪项属于指南所列的可治疗病因？

options.en: Chronic osteoarthritis
options.zh: 慢性骨关节炎

options.en: Tension pneumothorax
options.zh: 张力性气胸

options.en: Seasonal allergies without exposure
options.zh: 未接触过敏原的季节性过敏

options.en: A healed old fracture
options.zh: 已愈合的陈旧骨折

questions.explanationEn: Listed treatable causes include hypovolemia, hypoxia, hydrogen ion (acidosis), hypo/hyperkalemia, hypothermia, tension pneumothorax, cardiac tamponade, toxins including anaphylaxis, and pulmonary or coronary thrombosis.
questions.explanationZh: 所列可治疗病因包括低血容量、缺氧、酸中毒、低/高钾血症、低体温、张力性气胸、心包填塞、毒素（含过敏性休克）以及肺或冠状动脉血栓。

questions.questionEn: A 47-year-old goes into cardiac arrest minutes after a wasp sting, with facial swelling and hives. How does this history influence your management?
questions.questionZh: 一名 47 岁男性被黄蜂蜇伤数分钟后发生心搏骤停，伴面部肿胀和荨麻疹。这一病史如何影响你的处置？

options.en: Toxins including anaphylaxis are a reversible cause, so transport can be considered with ongoing CPR
options.zh: 包括过敏性休克在内的毒素属可逆病因，因此可考虑在持续 CPR 下转运

options.en: The history is irrelevant once the patient is in arrest
options.zh: 患者一旦骤停，病史就无关紧要

options.en: Resuscitation should be stopped because anaphylaxis is always fatal
options.zh: 应终止复苏，因为过敏性休克必然致命

options.en: CPR should be withheld and only Epinephrine given
options.zh: 不做心肺复苏，只给肾上腺素

questions.explanationEn: The decision to transport is multifactorial and relies on history and physical examination for clues about reversible causes. Toxins including anaphylaxis are a listed reversible cause, so intra-arrest transport can be considered.
questions.explanationZh: 是否转运是多因素决定，依赖病史和体检寻找可逆病因的线索。包括过敏性休克在内的毒素属所列可逆病因，因此可考虑在骤停状态下转运。
